=You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule:

Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says \"remote.\"

Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.

Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.

Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.

Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.

Keep the job only if one of these is true:

The job says worldwide remote.

The job says work from anywhere.

The job says global remote.

The job says APAC remote.

The job allows international contractors.

The job accepts people based anywhere.

The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

Return JSON only:

parameters.content:
## Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

Runs every day at 8:30 AM Asia/Taipei (set Workflow Settings > Timezone to Asia/Taipei).

Pipeline: fetch jobs -> normalize -> dedupe vs Google Sheets -> hard-filter country/onsite restrictions -> AI Taiwan-eligibility check -> async + role + salary scoring -> write to Google Sheets (Raw Jobs / Filtered Jobs / Rejected) -> Telegram/Gmail digest -> auto-draft cover letters for 85+ scores.

Before running: create the 'Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs' Google Sheet (see README for the 4 tabs and columns) and attach Google Sheets, OpenAI, and Telegram/Gmail credentials to the relevant nodes.

Wellfound, Dynamite Jobs, YC Work at a Startup, and Otta have no public API/RSS (YC and Otta also require a login), so plain HTTP scraping won't reliably work. These 4 fetch + normalize node pairs are disabled placeholders - wire up a scraping API or an authenticated browser tool here if you want them included. RemoteOK, Remotive, We Work Remotely, and Himalayas are fully wired up via their public API/RSS feeds.
Disabled by default - Telegram is the default alert/digest channel. Enable a Gmail node (and optionally disable its Telegram neighbor) if you'd rather get email, or enable both.

This workflow prepares everything (score, eligibility verdict, cover letter draft) but never submits an application automatically. application_status = 'ready_to_apply' just means Jerry should apply manually today; move the row to the Applied tab once he does.
